scope_notice: Scope and use: statistical analysis supporting the appraiser's adjustment development. Per-unit rates and value curves are model estimates with stated uncertainty, not confirmed market facts. The appraiser makes all final adjustment selections. No indicated, reconciled or opinion-of-value figure is produced. Prepared with reference to USPAP Advisory Opinion 41 (Use of Technology in an Appraisal or Appraisal Review Assignment): the tool cannot comply with USPAP; the appraiser remains responsible for judging whether this output is accurate and relevant to the assignment.

notes: Raw Bright MLS export detected; mapped to standard schema (bedrooms and baths above grade; blank garage, half bath and carport = 0).
Price screen: 2 sale(s) sold for more than 3x above or below what the time model expects for their features and date; left out of both pools and listed in exclusions: DEMO200019, DEMO200176.
Cleaning: 320 sales in file, 307 clean, 13 excluded. Effective date 2026-09-15, sale age from closing date, window 2021-05-08 to 2026-08-18.

Listing weights: 37 of 307 clean sales count for less because a bedroom, bath, garage or carport count sits more than 2 away from what is typical for their size (the median of the nearest 61 sales by GLA), or a finished basement has its lower-level rooms left blank while the main line shows more rooms than typical. Nothing is dropped for this; the list is in listing_weights.csv.

Time index: 307 clean sales, log-price model with the model features and quarter of the year; bends allowed every 6 months with 20 sales on each side (9 candidate dates). Kept: overall slope. R-squared 0.857 (weighted). 49 sale(s) priced far from the time model got less weight.
Adjustment pool: 281 of 307 clean sales inside your ranges (lot_sf 5,000 to any; year_built 1968 to any).
Lines priced: Site, Bedrooms, Full baths, Half baths, Gross living area, Garage, Carport, Pool. Background controls in both models, never priced: year built, levels, finished basement.
Adjustment model: MARS left out bedrooms, half baths, carport, levels, finished basement; each went back in as a straight line so every priced line gets a number and a range.
Weighted fit: 54 of 281 pool sales priced far from the model (beyond 1.345 robust standard deviations) got less weight; with the listing weights the pool counts as 266 full-weight sales.

Held-out test (5-fold x 16, the same folds for both models): MARS pooled out-of-fold R-squared 0.77, typical miss 5.4%; multiple regression 0.79, typical miss 5.2%. MARS cross-validated R-squared averaged fold by fold 0.77 (sd 0.05).
Comps not in the modeled data: MANUAL001 (not in the sales file); MANUAL002 (not in the sales file).
Comps outside the adjustment-pool ranges: DEMO200033.

Comp listings that look off by the same test the pool sales get: C3 4066 Briar Gate Pl (finished basement with the lower-level rooms left blank and more above-grade rooms than typical (basement rooms probably listed on the main line)); C4 4099 Fox Hollow Dr (6 garage spaces where 2 is typical for its size).

FHFA check: FHFA all-transactions HPI, Fairfax County, VA (FRED ATNHPIUS51059A), annual, 2010 to 2025 (ends before the effective date, so its changes run to 2025 only). Compared with this index over the same annual periods.
Leave-comps-out check: refit without the 3 comp(s) in the adjustment pool; 0 MARS comp line(s) and 0 multiple-regression rate(s) moved outside their half-sample range.
Older comps (sold more than 12 months before the effective date): C1 2022-07-31; C2 2022-06-15; C3 2024-12-12; C4 2024-08-23.

time_index.method: Quality-adjusted log-price index from 307 clean sales: log price on site, bedrooms, full baths, half baths, gross living area, garage, carport, pool, year built, levels, finished basement, quarter of the year (reported, not applied), plus a time curve that may bend only on calendar dates every 6 months, with at least 20 sales on each side (10 in the half-sample refits, which use half the sales), bends pruned by GCV (penalty 2). Listings far from typical and prices far from the model count for less (listing and Huber weights). Prices in the adjustment pool are brought to the effective date with it before either model prices the features.
